observations: Photo 0 shows a closed white chest freezer under blue light with a control panel on the lid and a front handle.
Photo 1 shows the open empty interior with a wire basket and an interior light.
Photo 2 shows the front of the closed unit with peeling paper or sticker residue on the lower front panel.
All three photos carry the same "POSTED ON JIJI TEMPLE NWACHUKWU" overlay.

claims.evidence: Brand name is not legible in photos 0 or 2; it appears only in the seller's text.
Photos show some cosmetic wear, but usage history cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: Cooling system or compressor may not work.
risks.proof: Video of the unit running with a thermometer inside showing temperature.

risks.risk: Lid gasket may be torn or not sealing properly.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the gasket or a paper-seal test.

risks.risk: Thermostat or control panel may be faulty.
risks.proof: Video of the thermostat being adjusted with the compressor responding.

risks.risk: Sides and rear may have rust or impact damage not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of all exterior sides and the back of the unit.

risks.risk: Interior may have stains or odor hidden by blue lighting.
risks.proof: Daylight interior photos without a color filter.

proof_requests: Video of the freezer running with a visible thermometer inside.
Close-up photo of the lid gasket seal.
Daylight photos of the left, right, and rear exterior.
Video of the thermostat being turned and the compressor responding.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a chest deep freezer from the photos; the brand and working condition are unproven, so it is priced at worst case as a non-working unit of unknown brand.
